race.description: Weddings & Celebrations @ Port City Bowling Club Hcp (C3)
race.comment: VIA FLAMINIA (4) is third-up now on the back of a solid effort at Newcastle, coming back to country level this time as she steps out to a more suitable distance. Smyth's claim comes in handy and with a better draw on offer out in trip, she can sit closer and put her best foot forward. BRILLIANT KNIGHT (6) comes here off a short break after tackling an Open race at Coffs Harbour 64 days ago. Back in trip, but Rolls has a successful record when riding and he maps to get every chance. Still has upside and can put his best foot forward. INCEPTION (3) was solid from the front in stronger company at Wyong last time out and if he adopts similar tactics in this race, he'll be hard to fend off. EASY TRAPEZEE (9) was too good last start at Dubbo and has upside to suggest he can handle the rise in trip now.
